C. Paleness, tiredness, stomach pain, increase in blood pressure, headache - These are general symptoms that could be caused by many conditions.

D. Runny nose, Hyperpigmentation, palmar hyperkeratoses, distal loss of sensitivity - This includes the characteristic skin changes (hyperpigmentation and palmar hyperkeratoses) and peripheral neuropathy (distal loss of sensitivity) that are hallmarks of chronic arsenic poisoning.

E. Tremor, mask face, rigidity, tremors, recurrent bronchopneumonia - These symptoms are more characteristic of Parkinson's disease or other movement disorders.
